Sam: FYI - Rack r18-apac has recurring p99 spikes since 08:50 UTC. GPU-2 thermal throttle + NVLink retries. Impacting one dedicated pool and several shared slices.
Leila: Any short logs?
Sam: log: `2026-03-23T08:50:11Z WARN gpu[2] temp=93C nvlink_err=7 p99=1.4s`
allocator-bot: Auto-action: moved offenders to soft-reserve pool: soft-fraction-12 (ttl=15m).
Ravi: We should avoid immediate full carveouts. Suggest a 3-step isolation ladder: 1) soft-fraction (TTL short), 2) prefer quantized/low-mem variant routing, 3) escalate to manual dedicated if churn persists.
Casey: Ops can run a 10% canary redirect for top 5 tenants and monitor quality set.
Leila: Prom queries to watch: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (tenant))`, `sum(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[1m])) by (tenant)`, `node_thermal{rack="r18"}`
Ravi: Add backoff: if tenant flips >3x in 20m, flag for manual review and pin for 24h. Also make thresholds region-configurable (APAC higher baseline).
allocator-bot: Canary pool created: frac-canary-789. Routes applied for tenants [t-21,t-99,t-404].
Sam: Starting canary now. Will post first telemetry in ~12m.
allocator-bot: Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/isolations/frac-canary-789
Sam: Update after 12m - canary tenants p99 down 55% (1.4s -> ~630ms), kvcache-evicts down 48%. Expanding to 25% traffic.
Casey: Good. Keep thermal-proactive-drain on and avoid hard carveouts until we have postmortem.
Leila: I'll collect traces and add to incident log. Ravi, can you sketch allocator config flags?
Ravi: config example: `isolation_ladder: p99_ms=600; evict_s=15; persist_min=4; churn_limit=3; region_overrides:{apac:{p99_ms=700}}`
Sam: Thanks. Leave canary running and we'll reconvene if thermal doesn't recover in 30m.
